title: FootprintRAG: Visual Analytics for Evidence Context Refinement in RAG-based Scientific Literature Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2609.19601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly used to ground large language model (LLM) outputs in scientific literature. However, in open-ended literature exploration, the evidence context used for generation is often produced through hidden retrieval, reranking, assessment, and filtering steps. Users may receive retrieval summaries without knowing how the system constructed the evidence context, which evidence units were retained or discarded, or whether potentially useful evidence was excluded before synthesis. We present FootprintRAG, an LLM-agent-powered visual analytics system for evidence context refinement in RAG-based scientific literature exploration. The core idea is to treat the RAG evidence context as an explicit, inspectable, and revisable analytical object before generation. translated_title: FootprintRAG：面向基于RAG的科学文献探索中证据上下文优化的可视分析系统
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）越来越多地被用于将大语言模型（LLM）的输出建立在科学文献基础之上。然而，在开放式的文献探索中，用于生成的证据上下文通常是通过隐藏的检索、重排序、评估和过滤等步骤产生的。用户可能仅收到检索摘要，却无从得知系统是如何构建证据上下文的、哪些证据单元被保留或丢弃，以及是否有潜在有用的证据在综合生成之前被排除在外。我们提出了FootprintRAG，一个由LLM智能体驱动的可视分析系统，用于在基于RAG的科学文献探索中对证据上下文进行优化。其核心思想是在生成之前将RAG证据上下文视为一个显式的、可检查的、可修订的分析对象。FootprintRAG将科学文献解析为文本和图表证据单元，将初始查询扩展为并行的查询变体，检索……
tldr: FootprintRAG是一个由LLM智能体驱动的可视分析系统，其核心创新在于将RAG的证据上下文视为显式、可检查、可修订的分析对象，让用户能够在生成之前透明地审视并优化证据的构建过程。
en_tdlr: FootprintRAG is an LLM-agent-powered visual analytics system whose core contribution is treating the RAG evidence context as an explicit, inspectable, and revisable analytical object, enabling users to transparently examine and refine evidence construction before generation.
